<script>
(function(){
'use strict';
function qs(s){return document.querySelector(s)}

function nfc(s){return String(s).normalize('NFC')}

var KEY='tkbm_idx';
var CONS=['B','C','D','Đ','G','H','K','L','M','N','P','Q','R','S','T','V','X'].map(nfc);
var FAM=['A','Ă','Â','E','Ê','I','O','Ô','Ơ','U','Ư','Y'];
var TMARK=['','\u0300','\u0301','\u0309','\u0303','\u0323'];  /* thường, huyền, sắc, hỏi, ngã, nặng */

var idx=0,cfg={mode:0},ans='',letters=[],groups=[],N=0,row=[],locked=false,shOn=false,wTok=0;
var boxEls=[],blEls=[],slotOf=[],bs=40,gap=8,cols=1,boxW=300;
var shT=0,nextT=0,failT=0;

function rnd(a,b){return a+Math.random()*(b-a)}
function rndInt(a,b){return Math.floor(rnd(a,b+1))}
function isLetter(ch){return /\p{L}/u.test(ch)}
function say(t,c){var m=qs('#msg');m.textContent=t||'';m.className=c||''}

/* ---------- lưu / đọc tiến độ ---------- */
function loadIdx(){var v=0;try{v=parseInt(localStorage.getItem(KEY),10)}catch(e){}return v>=0?v:0}
function saveIdx(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,String(idx))}catch(e){}}

/* ---------- độ khó theo vị trí trong danh sách ---------- */
function cfgFor(i){
 var q=i*200/Math.max(1,STRING_LIST.length);
 if(q<20)return{mode:0};
 if(q<60)return{mode:1,idle:[8000,14000],burst:[1,1],dur:600};
 if(q<110)return{mode:2,idle:[4500,8500],burst:[2,3],step:[950,1200],dur:520};
 if(q<160)return{mode:2,idle:[2800,5500],burst:[3,5],step:[700,900],dur:420};
 var t=Math.min(1,(q-160)/40);
 return{mode:2,idle:[1800-t*600,3600-t*1000],burst:[4,7+Math.round(t*3)],step:[520-t*70,700-t*120],dur:340};
}

/* ---------- modal ---------- */
function modal(t,x,btns){
 qs('#mt').textContent=t;qs('#mx').textContent=x;var m=qs('#mb');m.innerHTML='';
 btns.forEach(function(a){var e=document.createElement('button');e.className='b '+(a[2]||'');e.textContent=a[0];e.onclick=a[1];m.appendChild(e)});
 qs('#md').hidden=false;
}
function hideModal(){qs('#md').hidden=true}

/* ---------- hiệu ứng ---------- */
function flash(c){var f=qs('#fx');f.className='';void f.offsetWidth;f.className=c}
var cv=qs('#cf'),cx=cv.getContext('2d'),parts=[],raf=0,lastT=0,until=0,dpr=1;
var CCOL=['#ef4444','#f59e0b','#fde047','#22c55e','#38bdf8','#a78bfa','#f472b6','#ffffff'];
function sizeCv(){dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;cv.width=Math.floor(innerWidth*dpr);cv.height=Math.floor(innerHeight*dpr)}
function spawn(x,y,n,spd,ang,spr){
 for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
  var a=ang+(Math.random()-.5)*spr,v=spd*(.45+Math.random()*.75);
  parts.push({x:x,y:y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,w:5+Math.random()*6,h:3+Math.random()*5,rot:Math.random()*6.28,vr:(Math.random()-.5)*.4,c:CCOL[Math.random()*CCOL.length|0],life:1,dec:.004+Math.random()*.007});
 }
}
function tickC(t){
 var dt=Math.min(40,t-(lastT||t))/16.7;lastT=t;
 cx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);cx.clearRect(0,0,innerWidth,innerHeight);
 parts=parts.filter(function(p){return p.life>0&&p.y<innerHeight+30});
 parts.forEach(function(p){
  p.vy+=.28*dt;p.vx*=.992;p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.rot+=p.vr*dt;p.life-=p.dec*dt;
  cx.save();cx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,p.life*1.6));cx.translate(p.x,p.y);cx.rotate(p.rot);cx.fillStyle=p.c;cx.fillRect(-p.w/2,-p.h/2,p.w,p.h);cx.restore();
 });
 if(parts.length||t<until)raf=requestAnimationFrame(tickC);else{raf=0;lastT=0;cx.clearRect(0,0,innerWidth,innerHeight)}
}
function fireworks(){
 var W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight;
 sizeCv();
 spawn(0,H,70,17,-Math.PI/3,.9);spawn(W,H,70,17,-Math.PI*2/3,.9);
 for(var k=0;k<7;k++)(function(k){setTimeout(function(){
  spawn(W*(.12+Math.random()*.76),H*(.12+Math.random()*.38),60,9.5,0,6.28);
  if(k%3===1){spawn(0,H,40,16,-Math.PI/3,.9);spawn(W,H,40,16,-Math.PI*2/3,.9)}
 },300+k*260)})(k);
 until=performance.now()+2600;
 if(!raf){lastT=0;raf=requestAnimationFrame(tickC)}
}

/* ---------- hộp chữ cái ---------- */
function randPerm(n){var a=[],i,j,t;for(i=0;i<n;i++)a.push(i);for(i=n-1;i>0;i--){j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t}return a}
function shown(sl){var a=[];for(var k=0;k<N;k++)a[sl[k]]=letters[k];return a.join('')}
function slotXY(s){
 var r=Math.floor(s/cols),c=s%cols,last=Math.floor((N-1)/cols),inRow=r===last?N-r*cols:cols;
 var x0=(boxW-(inRow*bs+(inRow-1)*gap))/2;
 return[x0+c*(bs+gap),r*(bs+gap)];
}
function applyPos(){
 for(var k=0;k<N;k++){var p=slotXY(slotOf[k]);boxEls[k].style.transform='translate('+Math.round(p[0])+'px,'+Math.round(p[1])+'px)'}
}
function hop(k){
 var el=boxEls[k];el.classList.add('hop');
 setTimeout(function(){el.classList.remove('hop')},(cfg.dur||500)+80);
}
function buildBoxes(){
 var wrap=qs('#boxes');wrap.innerHTML='';boxEls=[];
 for(var k=0;k<N;k++){var el=document.createElement('div');el.className='box';el.textContent=letters[k];wrap.appendChild(el);boxEls.push(el)}
 var tries=0,target=letters.join('');
 do{slotOf=randPerm(N);tries++}while(N>1&&tries<40&&shown(slotOf)===target);
}
function layoutRow(){
 var w=qs('#row').clientWidth||(innerWidth-28),mw=1;
 groups.forEach(function(g){if(g.length>mw)mw=g.length});
 var bw=Math.floor((w-8-(mw-1)*6)/mw);bw=Math.max(18,Math.min(44,bw));
 qs('#row').style.setProperty('--bw',bw+'px');
}
function layout(){
 var wrap=qs('#boxes');
 boxW=wrap.clientWidth||300;gap=8;
 var maxH=Math.max(110,Math.min(240,innerHeight*.28)),s=58,rows;
 for(;s>=26;s-=2){cols=Math.max(1,Math.floor((boxW+gap)/(s+gap)));rows=Math.ceil(N/cols);if(rows*(s+gap)-gap<=maxH)break}
 bs=Math.max(s,26);cols=Math.max(1,Math.floor((boxW+gap)/(bs+gap)));rows=Math.ceil(N/cols);
 wrap.style.height=(rows*(bs+gap)-gap)+'px';
 boxEls.forEach(function(el){el.style.width=el.style.height=bs+'px';el.style.fontSize=Math.round(bs*.62)+'px'});
 layoutRow();
}
function relayoutNow(){
 if(!N)return;
 var wrap=qs('#boxes');wrap.classList.add('nt');layout();applyPos();void wrap.offsetWidth;wrap.classList.remove('nt');
}

/* ---------- trộn hộp ---------- */
function fullShuffle(){
 if(N<2)return;
 var old=slotOf.slice(),np,tries=0;
 do{np=randPerm(N);tries++}while(tries<20&&shown(np)===shown(old));
 slotOf=np;for(var k=0;k<N;k++)if(old[k]!==np[k])hop(k);
 applyPos();
}
function swapSome(){
 if(N<2)return;
 var m=(N>=3&&Math.random()<.35)?3:2,ks,tries=0,ok;
 do{
  ks=randPerm(N).slice(0,m);
  ok=false;for(var i=1;i<ks.length;i++)if(letters[ks[i]]!==letters[ks[0]])ok=true;
  tries++;
 }while(!ok&&tries<15);
 var sl=ks.map(function(k){return slotOf[k]}),rot=sl.slice(1).concat(sl[0]);
 ks.forEach(function(k,i){slotOf[k]=rot[i];hop(k)});
 applyPos();
}
function schedule(){
 clearTimeout(shT);
 if(!shOn||cfg.mode===0||N<2)return;
 var my=wTok;
 shT=setTimeout(function(){if(my!==wTok||!shOn)return;burst(my)},rnd(cfg.idle[0],cfg.idle[1]));
}
function burst(my){
 var n=rndInt(cfg.burst[0],cfg.burst[1]);
 (function step(){
  if(my!==wTok||!shOn)return;
  if(n--<=0){schedule();return}
  if(cfg.mode===1)fullShuffle();else swapSome();
  shT=setTimeout(step,cfg.mode===1?0:rnd(cfg.step[0],cfg.step[1]));
 })();
}

/* ---------- hàng đoán ---------- */
function buildRow(){
 var h='',k=0;
 groups.forEach(function(g){h+='<span class="wd">';g.forEach(function(){h+='<span class="bl" data-i="'+(k++)+'"></span>'});h+='</span>'});
 var r=qs('#row');r.innerHTML=h;blEls=Array.prototype.slice.call(r.querySelectorAll('.bl'));
}
function renderRow(){
 blEls.forEach(function(el,i){el.textContent=row[i]||'';el.className='bl'+(row[i]?' f':'')});
}
function markRow(c){blEls.forEach(function(el){el.classList.add(c)})}

/* ---------- nhập liệu ---------- */
function addChar(ch){
 if(locked||!N||row.length>=N)return;
 row.push(nfc(ch).toUpperCase());say('');renderRow();evaluate();
}
function del(){
 if(locked||!N)return;
 row.pop();say('');renderRow();
}
function clearAll(){
 if(locked||!N)return;
 row=[];say('');renderRow();
}
function evaluate(){
 if(row.length<N)return;
 if(nfc(row.join(''))===nfc(letters.join('')))success();else fail();
}
function fail(){
 locked=true;markRow('bad');
 say('Từ khoá sai. Mời bạn đoán lại.','bad');flash('r');
 var my=wTok;
 failT=setTimeout(function(){if(my!==wTok)return;row=[];renderRow();locked=false},1000);
}
function success(){
 locked=true;shOn=false;clearTimeout(shT);markRow('ok');
 slotOf=boxEls.map(function(_,k){return k});
 qs('#boxes').style.setProperty('--dur','700ms');
 boxEls.forEach(function(el){el.classList.add('win')});applyPos();
 say('Chính xác! 🎉 '+String(STRING_LIST[idx]),'ok');flash('g');fireworks();
 var my=wTok;
 nextT=setTimeout(function(){if(my!==wTok)return;nextWord()},3000);
}
function nextWord(){
 idx++;saveIdx();
 if(idx>=STRING_LIST.length)showEnd();else loadWord();
}
function showEnd(){
 N=0;clearTimers();
 modal('🏆 Hoàn thành!','Bạn đã giải xong cả '+STRING_LIST.length+' từ khoá bí mật.',[['Chơi lại từ đầu',function(){hideModal();idx=0;saveIdx();loadWord()},'on']]);
}
function clearTimers(){clearTimeout(shT);clearTimeout(nextT);clearTimeout(failT);shOn=false;wTok++}

/* ---------- nạp từ khoá ---------- */
function loadWord(){
 clearTimers();
 ans=nfc(String(STRING_LIST[idx])).toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
 groups=ans.split(' ').map(function(w){return Array.from(w).filter(isLetter)}).filter(function(g){return g.length});
 letters=[].concat.apply([],groups);N=letters.length;
 row=[];locked=false;cfg=cfgFor(idx);shOn=true;
 qs('#lv').textContent='Câu '+(idx+1)+'/'+STRING_LIST.length;
 qs('#boxes').style.setProperty('--dur',(cfg.dur||500)+'ms');
 say('Sắp xếp các chữ cái trong hộp thành từ khoá bí mật.','hint');
 buildBoxes();buildRow();renderRow();
 var wrap=qs('#boxes');wrap.classList.add('nt');layout();applyPos();void wrap.offsetWidth;wrap.classList.remove('nt');
 saveIdx();schedule();
}

/* ---------- bàn phím ảo (bàn phím máy tính không dùng được) ---------- */
function keyBtn(ch,cls){return '<button class="k'+(cls?' '+cls:'')+'" tabindex="-1" data-l="'+ch+'">'+ch+'</button>'}
function buildKb(){
 var h='<div class="kr kc">'+CONS.slice(0,9).map(function(c){return keyBtn(c)}).join('')+'</div>';
 h+='<div class="kr kc">'+CONS.slice(9).map(function(c){return keyBtn(c)}).join('')+'<button class="k d" tabindex="-1" data-a="del">⌫</button></div>';
 var keys=[];
 FAM.forEach(function(b,i){TMARK.forEach(function(m){keys.push(keyBtn(nfc(b+m),i%2?'fb':''))})});
 for(var r=0;r<6;r++)h+='<div class="kr kv">'+keys.slice(r*12,r*12+12).join('')+'</div>';
 h+='<div class="kr"><button class="k d" tabindex="-1" data-a="clr">🗑 Xoá hết</button></div>';
 var kb=qs('#kb');kb.innerHTML=h;
 kb.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){e.preventDefault()});
 kb.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  var b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;
  if(b.dataset.l)addChar(b.dataset.l);
  else if(b.dataset.a==='del')del();
  else if(b.dataset.a==='clr')clearAll();
 });
}
addEventListener('resize',function(){relayoutNow();sizeCv()});

/* ---------- khởi động ---------- */
buildKb();sizeCv();
idx=loadIdx();
if(idx>=STRING_LIST.length)showEnd();else loadWord();
/*TESTHOOK*/
})();
</script>
</body></html>
